result.title: Dynamic Spectrum Re-parameterized Convolution for Cost-free Image Enhancement
result.summary: Image enhancement spans degradations with distinct spectral characteristics. Standard convolutions use fixed kernels, whereas dynamic convolutions gain adaptability at additional inference cost. We propose Dynamic Spectrum Re-parameterized Convolution (DSRC), a plug-and-play module that learns task-adaptive spectral responses during training while retaining standard convolution at inference. DSRC decomposes convolution kernels into frequency bands, applies learnable high/low-pass modulation, and incorporates lightweight residual branches. Owing to the linearity of these operations, all training-time components are analytically fused into a single kernel for inference. Experiments on low-light enhancement, underwater enhancement, and image super-resolution show consistent PSNR gains and generally improved or preserved SSIM and LPIPS across twelve backbone-task configurations, with unchanged deployed parameter counts and theoretical FLOPs, and no additional inference operators.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 DSRC：训练时把卷积核分解为频带并加可学习高通/低通调制与轻量残差分 支，推理时因线性性解析融合为单一标准卷积，用于低照度、水下增强与超分。
AI.relevance_reason: 属低层图像增强的卷积重参数化工作，目标是像素质量提升，不涉及视觉推理状态、证据筛选、停止决策或 latent 表示使用，与 LVR 主线无实质联系；「训练增益、推理无额外成本」仅为通用效率思路，缺少可供核查的具体迁移线索。
